case_title: NICOLE GULLY VS. MARIA VELIZ ET AL

docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $109.20 FILED BY GULLY, NICOLE AS TO DEFENDANT VELIZ, MARIA VELIZ, LIZ ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR JAN-07-2022 AT 01:30 PM IN DEPT 506
PROOF OF SERVICE FILED ON CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF (FEE FOR SERVICE:$60.00) SERVED SEP-18-2021, PERSONAL SERVICE AS TO DEFENDANT VELIZ, MARIA
PROOF OF SERVICE FILED ON CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF (FEE FOR SERVICE:$NO AMOUNT GIVEN) SERVED SEP-18-2021, PERSONAL SERVICE AS TO DEFENDANT VELIZ, LIZ

SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF JAN-07-2022 - CONTINUED FOR PROGRESS REPORT TO FEB-08-2022 AT 3:30 PM IN DEPT. 506. PLAINTIFF NICOLE GULLY IS PRESENT. DEFENDANT MARIA VELIZ IS PRESENT. DEFENDANT LIZ VELIZ IS PRESENT. PARTIES CAME TO A SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT IN COURT FOR A PAYMENT OF $170.60 (INCLUDES COST) TO THE PLAINTIFF. INTEREST FROM OCTOBER 17, 2017, THROUGH OCTOBER 17, 2021, FOR A TOTAL INTEREST OF $80.60 PLUS COURT COST OF $90.00. DEFENDANT AGREED TO PAY PLAINTIFF BY CHECK IN THE HALLWAY OF THE COURTS JANUARY 7, 2022. APPEARANCE IS REQUIRED AT THE FEBRUARY 08, 2022, HEARING IF NO PAYMENT IS MADE. IF NO APPEARANCES THE CASE WILL BE DISMISSED WITH PREJUDICE PER SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT.NO EXHIBITS RETAINED. PRIOR TO THE HEARING HONORABLE MICHELLE TONG GAVE DISCLOSURE ABOUT CAMPAIGN CONTRIBUTIONS MADE. JUDGE: MICHELLE TONG; CLERK: A. DATT. NOT REPORTED. (D506)
ORDER CASE CONTINUED FOR PROGRESS REPORT: PENDING SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT. (SEE SCANNED DOCUMENT FOR DETAILS.)
ORDER DISMISSED WITH PREJUDICE. CASE SETTLED.
THE COURT ORDERS DISMISSAL OF THE ENTIRE ACTION WITH PREJUDICE. NO APPEARANCES. CASE SETTLED. JUDGE: MICHELLE TONG; CLERK: W. TRUPEK. NOT REPORTED.(506)
